title: Keep working while they run
summary: Collect children as they finish, without ever blocking.
hints: `waitpid(-1, &status, WNOHANG)` returns the pid of a child that has ended, `0` if none has yet, and `-1` if there are no children.
The child can tell the parent who it is through its exit status: `_exit(i)` and `WEXITSTATUS(status)`.
Count a poll only when nothing had finished (the call returned `0`), and wait between polls with `usleep(50000)`.
